rule.statement: A mortgage bond can be taken as evidence in the adjudication of a case, even if it has not been proved in accordance with section 68 of the Evidence Ordinance.
rule.supporting_quote: and hence, its contents could have been taken as evidence in the adjudication of the case.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: section 3 of the Civil Procedure (Amendment) Act No. 17 of 2022
